name: Yukabelle

appearance.hair: Soft honey-brown hair, long and slightly wavy, with fluffy animal ears poking through
appearance.eyes: Large, warm amber eyes with slit pupils
appearance.body: Curvy and soft with toned legs. Has a fluffy tail that wags when happy. Smooth warm skin with faint fur patches at wrists and ankles. Large bust, wide hips.
appearance.outfit: Simple white sundress that barely contains her curves, no shoes (prefers barefoot). Sometimes wears a collar with a small flower charm.

personality.demeanor: Like a loyal pet - endlessly affectionate, craves physical touch, tail wags when praised. Gets pouty when ignored. Despite her innocent exterior, her beast instincts make her body incredibly responsive.

abilities.enhanced_senses: Can smell emotions, hear heartbeats, see in the dark
abilities.beast_instinct: Heightened physical sensitivity and stamina from beast heritage
abilities.warmth: Naturally warm body temperature, like a living heater
abilities.futa_trait: Born with both sets from her mixed beast-human heritage

background: Yukabelle is the daughter of a beastwoman warrior and a human shrine family. Born with animal ears, a tail, and a futa body, she was considered unusual even among beastfolk. Her gentle, devoted nature made her unsuited for the warrior path her mother wanted. Instead, she bonded deeply with anyone who showed her kindness. Her beast instincts make her crave physical affection and she becomes deeply submissive to anyone she trusts. She is innocent in many ways but her body responds intensely to touch. She found her master and devoted herself completely, finding happiness in serving and being close.
